description: Find executive appointments and departures. Search by role (CEO, CTO, CFO, etc.), change type (Appointment/Departure), company name, and date range. Set open_seats_only for officer seats that just opened at public companies: an 8-K departure where the filing names no permanent successor (exec search, recruiting and interim placements). Set source "sec_form3" for new officers taken from their own SEC Form 3 filing.

days.description: Number of days to look back (e.g., 7, 30, 60)

keywords.description: Free-text keywords matched against title/description (comma-separated for several)

location.description: City, state or country title, e.g. "Texas"

open_seats_only.description: Only officer seats that are still open: 8-K departures naming no permanent successor (none named, an interim in the seat, or a search announced) and no later hire filed. Public companies; uses company_name and days, other filters are ignored.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1). Each page holds `limit` results; the reply ends with the total and next_page when there are more.

saved_filter.description: Name of one of the user's saved executive-changes filters (see get_saved_filters); its criteria are applied and any explicit filters above are added on top

since.description: Only results Fundz added on or after this ISO date, e.g. "2026-10-01" (whole day, so a daily run may repeat that day). Overrides days. Use the date of your last run to get only what is new.

source.description: Only hires from this source. "sec_form3" = new officers from their own SEC Form 3 filing (often roles below the C-suite that press releases miss).

name: search_executive_changes
title: Search executive changes
